Accelerator Q&A Apply to incubator Apply to incubator Apply to incubator Accelerator Q&A We are now open for applications to the 18th edition of our accelerator program! 🙌 Having run the program since 2016, we know there are a few things that people are curious about. To (potentially) save you the trouble of asking, we've answered some of the most common questions below. January 21, 2025 Category Want to submit your application right away? Click here! 1. Do you only accept software companies? No . While the majority of companies we’ve funded work with software, we’ve invested in everything from tablets and enterprise architecture to cameras, epigenetics and microphones. We work with a wide range of startups, and we’re eager to work with technology companies of all kinds. 2. Do we need to have a pitch-deck and a full business plan? No . We select companies based on what you write in your application, and then we meet with around 30 short-listed companies for an additional interview. 3. How much do you invest? Startuplab invest in all companies that are selected to the Startuplab accelerator program; typically 2-4 MNOK for targeted ownership of around 10% . But we’re flexible on both. 4. Do we have to live in Oslo or Bergen to apply? No . However, the core team should be able to travel to one of our hubs (Oslo/Bergen) during the three-month period of the program

But here’s the thing: most founders have a few “I wish I’d known this sooner” moments along the way. We’ve collected the top five we hear most often from our alumni, so you can start your accelerator journey one step ahead. August 13, 2025 Category 1. You wear many hats.. but you don’t have to wear them all at once In the early days, you’re CEO, sales team, marketer, product manager, customer support — and the person who remembers everything from booking important meetings to buying more coffee. An accelerator doesn’t take those hats away, but it does help you prioritise which ones to wear, and when. You’ll get mentors who’ve been in your shoes, guiding you on where to focus so your time (and your sanity!) stretch further. 2. Here’s Why Accelerators Make All the Difference Launching a startup is exciting, but let’s be honest — it’s also incredibly nerve-wracking. You’ve got big dreams, limited resources, and a never-ending to-do list. The good news is you don't have to do it on your own! A startup accelerator is built to help your business grow faster and smarter. If you’re on the fence, here’s a quick look at why it could make all the difference. January 23, 2025 Category 1. Access to Resources Accelerators are like the startup world’s cheat code. From work spaces and amenities to legal and financial guidance, accelerators give you access to resources that might otherwise be out of reach for an early-stage startup. Why burn through your budget when you can leverage these resources to focus on building and scaling? 2. Experienced Mentors One of the greatest perks of joining an accelerator is the access to experienced mentors who’ve been there and done that. These experts can help you avoid the common pitfalls, refine your business model, and even introduce you to their networks.
